# Inkberrow Dairy - pasteurizer CIP journal

One line per cycle start and per cycle completion, plus the rinse and
conductivity checks that surround them. Cycles run on the milk line (circuit
A) and the separator (circuit B) independently.

    <time> CIP circuit=<id> start
    <time> CIP circuit=<id> complete duration_min=<n>
